title.rendered: Building a 25-tph Single Stream Recycling Facility

content.rendered:
VAN DYK Recycling Solutions installed this Bollegraaf single stream recycling system at City Carting, Stamford, CT. Operating with just 16 manual sorters, it handles residential single stream loads and commercial material. The installation includes advanced systems from Lubo and TITECH.
